name: Paca – Professional AI Content Assistant
author: dxu

sections.description:
Integrate AI models to generate AI-powered content, excerpts, images, and proofreading assistance directly from the post editor.

Features

  • AI Excerpt generation
  • AI Image generation
  • Simple & Intuitive
  • OpenAI and Gemini models
  • Proofread and assist with content writing
  • Add front-end widget for content summaries
  • Enable for all post types or selected ones
  • Update excerpt length
  • Edit excerpt generation prompt
  • Use custom fields for enhanced AI results
  • Change image size
  • Use post excerpt as image generation prompt for enhanced AI results
  • Edit image generation prompt
  • Allow AI learn about website for enhanced AI results
  • Access additional AI models

Links

  • Website
  • Documentation
  • Pro
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Paca”
  3. Install and Activate Paca from your Plugins page
  4. Click on the new menu item under Settings > Paca
  5. Select your AI model
  6. Enter your API Key
sections.faq:
Is AI API key included?

No. The AI API Keys can be created using Google AI Studio or OpenAI API.
There are free versions available for each.
